summary: Infosys Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting routine quarterly and annual results of operations for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing announces a final dividend of INR 25 per share, the date of the 45th Annual General Meeting, and proposed auditor appointments. It also includes an amendment to extend the employee stock ownership program. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a standard earnings and corporate governance update, not a special situation.
